ei.title: The Benefits of Engaging with Poetry
ei.subject: 11월_2022 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Benefits of Engaging with Poetry

fullPassage: Developing a personal engagement with poetry brings a number of benefits to you as an individual, in both a personal and a professional capacity. Writing poetry has been shown to have physical and mental benefits, with expressive writing found to improve immune system and lung function, diminish psychological distress, and enhance relationships. Poetry has long been used to aid different mental health needs, develop empathy, and reconsider our relationship with both natural and built environments. Poetry is also an incredibly effective way of actively targeting the cognitive development period, improving your productivity and scientific creativity in the process. Poetry is considered to be an easy and useful means of expressing emotions, but you fall into frustration when you realize its complexity. In short, poetry has a lot to offer, if you give it the opportunity to do so.

questions.passage: Developing a personal engagement with poetry brings a number of benefits to you as an individual, in both a personal and a professional capacity. Writing poetry has been shown to have physical and mental benefits, with expressive writing found to improve immune system and lung function, diminish psychological distress, and (A)[enhance / harm] relationships. Poetry has long been used to aid different mental health needs, develop empathy, and reconsider our relationship with both natural and built environments. Poetry is also an incredibly (B)[useless / effective] way of actively targeting the cognitive development period, improving your productivity and scientific creativity in the process. Poetry is considered to be an easy and useful means of expressing emotions, but you fall into frustration when you realize its complexity. In short, poetry has a lot to (C)[withhold / offer], if you give it the opportunity to do so.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) enhance=향상시키다, (B) effective=효과적인, (C) offer=제공하다. 시는 관계를 향상시키고, 효과적인 방법이며, 제공할 것이 많다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① enhance - effective - offer: 시가 관계를 향상시키고(enhance), 효과적인(effective) 방법이며, 제공할(offer) 것이 많다는 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② harm - effective - offer: (A) harm(해치다)은 '관계를 향상시킨다'는 긍정적 문맥에 반대
❌ ③ enhance - useless - offer: (B) useless(쓸모없는)는 '효과적인 방법'이라는 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ enhance - effective - withhold: (C) withhold(주지 않다)는 '제공할 것이 많다'는 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 향상시키다(enhance) → 효과적인(effective) → 제공하다(offer)

questions.passage: Developing a personal engagement with poetry brings a number of benefits to you as an individual, in both a personal and a professional capacity. Writing poetry has been shown to have physical and mental benefits, with expressive writing found to improve immune system and lung function, (A)[diminish / increase] psychological distress, and enhance relationships. Poetry has long been used to aid different mental health needs, develop empathy, and (B)[ignore / reconsider] our relationship with both natural and built environments. Poetry is also an incredibly effective way of actively targeting the cognitive development period, improving your (C)[laziness / productivity] and scientific creativity in the process. Poetry is considered to be an easy and useful means of expressing emotions, but you fall into frustration when you realize its complexity. In short, poetry has a lot to offer, if you give it the opportunity to do so.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① increase - reconsider - productivity: (A) increase(늘리다)는 '심리적 고통을 줄인다'는 긍정적 효과 문맥에 반대
✅ ② diminish - reconsider - productivity: 고통을 줄이고(diminish), 관계를 재고하며(reconsider), 생산성(productivity)을 향상시킨다. 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ diminish - ignore - productivity: (B) ignore(무시하다)는 '관계를 재고한다'는 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ diminish - reconsider - laziness: (C) laziness(게으름)는 '향상시키는' 긍정적 대상 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 줄이다(diminish) → 재고하다(reconsider) → 생산성(productivity)

questions.passage: Developing a personal engagement with poetry brings a number of benefits to you as an individual, in both a personal and a professional capacity. Writing poetry has been shown to have physical and mental benefits, with expressive writing found to improve immune system and lung function, diminish psychological (A)[distress / comfort], and enhance relationships. Poetry has long been used to aid different mental health needs, develop (B)[hostility / empathy], and reconsider our relationship with both natural and built environments. Poetry is also an incredibly effective way of actively targeting the cognitive development period, improving your productivity and scientific (C)[confusion / creativity] in the process. Poetry is considered to be an easy and useful means of expressing emotions, but you fall into frustration when you realize its complexity. In short, poetry has a lot to offer, if you give it the opportunity to do so.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① comfort - empathy - creativity: (A) comfort(위안)는 '심리적 고통을 줄인다'는 문맥에 반대(위안을 줄일 리 없음)
❌ ② distress - hostility - creativity: (B) hostility(적대감)는 '공감을 기른다'는 긍정적 문맥에 반대
✅ ③ distress - empathy - creativity: 심리적 고통(distress)을 줄이고, 공감(empathy)을 기르며, 과학적 창의성(creativity)을 향상시킨다. 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ distress - empathy - confusion: (C) confusion(혼란)은 '향상시키는' 긍정적 대상 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 고통(distress) → 공감(empathy) → 창의성(creativity)

det.analysis: 동사 create(창조하다)를 명사형 creativity(창의성)로 변환합니다. 형용사 scientific(과학적인)의 꾸밈을 받는 명사 자리이고, 앞의 productivity(생산성)와 and로 나란히 연결되므로 같은 명사형이 와야 해요.
det.tip: create(동사) → creativity(명사, 창의성). 형용사(scientific) 뒤에는 명사!

questions.passage: Developing a personal engagement with poetry brings a number of benefits to you as an individual, in both a personal and a professional capacity. Writing poetry has been shown to have physical and mental benefits, with expressive writing found to improve immune system and lung function, diminish psychological distress, and enhance relationships. Poetry has long been used to aid different __________, develop empathy, and reconsider our relationship with both natural and built environments. Poetry is also an incredibly effective way of actively targeting the cognitive development period, improving your productivity and scientific creativity in the process. Poetry is considered to be an easy and useful means of expressing emotions, but you fall into frustration when you realize its complexity. In short, poetry has a lot to offer, if you give it the opportunity to do so.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시는 다양한 정신 건강 요구를 돕는 데 사용되어 왔다
det.analysis:
✅ ① mental health needs: 앞서 나온 심리적 고통 감소·공감 형성 등 정신 건강 관련 흐름에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② physical training goals: 신체 훈련 목표는 본문 흐름과 무관
❌ ③ financial security plans: 재정 관련은 본문에 없음
❌ ④ academic exam scores: 시험 점수는 본문에 없음
det.tip: used to aid different ______ → mental health needs(정신 건강 요구)

questions.passage: Developing a personal engagement with poetry brings a number of benefits to you as an individual, in both a personal and a professional capacity. Writing poetry has been shown to have __________, with expressive writing found to improve immune system and lung function, diminish psychological distress, and enhance relationships. Poetry has long been used to aid different mental health needs, develop empathy, and reconsider our relationship with both natural and built environments. Poetry is also an incredibly effective way of actively targeting the cognitive development period, improving your productivity and scientific creativity in the process. Poetry is considered to be an easy and useful means of expressing emotions, but you fall into frustration when you realize its complexity. In short, poetry has a lot to offer, if you give it the opportunity to do so.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시 쓰기는 신체적, 정신적 이점이 있는 것으로 나타났다
det.analysis:
❌ ① social and political power: 사회·정치 권력은 본문에 없음
✅ ② physical and mental benefits: 면역 체계 개선·심리적 고통 감소 등 뒤에 이어지는 구체적 예시가 신체적·정신적 이점을 뒷받침 ←정답
❌ ③ legal and financial risks: 법적·재정적 위험은 본문 취지와 반대
❌ ④ short and temporary effects: 일시적 효과는 본문에 없음
det.tip: shown to have ______ → physical and mental benefits(신체적·정신적 이점). 뒤 예시가 단서!
